headlines.name: Math115.InitialRuntimeNext.initialViews_weight_output
headlines.statement:
∀ (a b : ℕ),
  (∀ (z : List ℕ × List ℕ),
      OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.idealMarginThreshold z) ≤
        a * OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight z + b) →
    ∀ (z : List ℕ × List ℕ),
      OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight (Math115.LatticeSamplerPreparation.initialViews z) ≤
        12 * OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight z ^ 4 + (24 + 4 * a) * OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight z ^ 3 +
            (17 + 4 * b) * OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight z ^ 2 +
          3

headlines.name: Math115.InitialRuntimeNext.actual_initialConfiguration_polynomial
headlines.statement:
∃ P,
  P.natDegree ≤ 4032 ∧
    ∀ (z : Math115.LatticeSamplerPreparation.Margins × ℕ),
      Math115.LatticeSamplerPreparation.initialConfigurationRealizer.cost z +
          OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight (Math115.LatticeSamplerPreparation.initialConfiguration z) ≤
        Polynomial.eval (OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight z) P
